evidence: Full tank_core package test suite: all tests pass across every binary (unit, integration, doc-tests) with zero failures. Clippy clean (-D warnings), formatting check clean.

23 substrate unit tests pass including all required acceptance criteria tests: rooted_plants_increase_o2_penetration, root_oxygenation_proportional_to_biomass_with_diminishing_returns, floating_plant_biomass_does_not_increase_penetration, zero_root_biomass_yields_zero_oxygenation_bonus, root_oxygenation_uses_named_parameter, root_oxygenation_dynamic_tracks_biomass_growth_and_decline, root_oxygenation_requires_rootable_substrate_habitats, zero_rol_rate_removes_rooted_oxygenation_effects.

5 root_zone_oxygenation integration tests pass: planted_vs_unplanted_diverge_in_penetration_depth (500h), planted_substrate_denitrification_interaction (500h), root_oxygenation_reduces_hourly_denitrification_when_it_shrinks_suboxic_volume, planted_substrate_nitrification_surface_area (500h with nitrifier biomass and nitrate divergence), tracing_exposes_root_oxygenation.
40 save_load tests pass including save_load_with_active_cycle_state and save_load_resume_determinism — no regressions in serialization determinism.

ROL formula verified correct (substrate.rs:99-111): bonus = total_depth * (1 - exp(-(active_root_biomass_g * rol_rate_cm_per_g) / total_depth)). Saturating exponential: linear at low biomass, asymptotic to substrate depth at high biomass.
Guild filter verified (substrate.rs:143-146): only PlantGuild::RootFeedingRosette contributes to active root biomass. Floating/epiphytic/fast-stem guilds excluded.
rol_rate_cm_per_g is a named parameter in ProcessParams (process.rs:176-189) with serde default 0.15 cm/g, invariant-checked non-negative (invariants.rs:276), and present in default.toml (line 104).

step_substrate_zones returns SubstrateOxygenationBreakdown (substrate.rs:23-29) and engine.rs reuses the returned value for four budget metrics (base_o2_penetration_depth_cm, root_oxygenation_active_biomass_g, root_oxygenation_bonus_cm, o2_penetration_depth_cm) — no redundant recomputation.
Tracing output verified: structured tracing::debug! at substrate.rs:59-69 exposes base penetration, ROL bonus, active root biomass, and effective penetration as separate named fields.
temp_repro_factor_pub confirmed removed from codebase — zero grep hits across tank_core.
findings_or_gaps: Minor: from_parts (engine.rs:132) discards the SubstrateOxygenationBreakdown returned by step_substrate_zones during initialization. Harmless since init-time tracing is not needed, but a minor API inconsistency. Non-blocking.

Minor: root_oxygenation_active_biomass_g() internally calls compute_habitat_registry() on each invocation, and substrate_oxygenation_breakdown() also calls this function, creating a redundant registry computation within the substrate module. The engine-level double-computation was fixed in cr2, but this intra-module redundancy remains. Non-blocking — the computation is cheap.
follow_up_or_amendments: No blocking amendments required. All acceptance criteria are satisfied with passing tests, clean clippy, and clean formatting across the full tank_core package.
